$about: The base components of the portfolio's design system. Every agent that builds reads this before writing UI: if a component here does the job, use it; if none does, ask before inventing one. /styleguide renders every example below. The build fails if a file in src/components/system/ is missing here or the other way round.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.purpose: The top bar on the black frame: the á (home), the menu (Play, Work, About, Contact), 'Based in' with the Barcelona time, 'Up for' and the email.
components.use: Once per page, at the top of the frame. Base.astro adds it unless the page places it itself (nav={false}). On a case, pass current={label, value} to show which case you're in.
components.avoid: Adding links to the menu (it is in the brief: Play and Work, plus About and Contact). Writing the status line by hand: it comes from Keystatic (home → status).

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: The same footer on every page: LinkedIn, the CV and Let's talk.
components.use: At the bottom of every page, on the black frame. Base.astro adds it (footer={false} to leave it out).
components.avoid: Repeating these links elsewhere on a page: they live here.

components.name: Panel
components.purpose: The paper sheet inside the black frame, radius 12.
components.use: The main surface of a page. tone='ink' for long pages (About, How this portfolio is built).
components.avoid: Panels inside panels; shadows on it.

example.slot: A paper panel. Everything sits on one of these.

components.name: Label
components.purpose: The small capitals of the interface (Space Grotesk, --fs-label).
components.use: Above values, on captions, in rows. tone='accent' makes a pill in the case's agent colour.
components.avoid: Sentences in capitals; labels in Satoshi or the serif.

components.name: DataPair
components.purpose: The one data pattern: a grey capital label (Space Grotesk) and its value (Satoshi).
components.use: Every fact: year, role, company, via. Inside a <dl>.
components.avoid: Any other way of showing facts (bold value, inline 'Year: 2024').

components.name: TitleCard
components.purpose: How a case introduces itself: its name in the serif (the important part in italics) and its facts.
components.use: At the top of every case. Write the title with **…** around the part in italics.
components.avoid: More than five facts; facts that repeat what another page already says.

components.name: ChapterHeading
components.purpose: A numbered chapter: the number in the agent colour, the title in the serif.
components.use: Each chapter of a case (Context, Role, Process, Result in Work cases). Put accentVars(agent) on a parent.
components.avoid: Numbers in plain text; chapter titles in Space Grotesk.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: The black button with an arrow in the agent colour (red when there is no agent).
components.use: Actions and links that open something: open a case, download, visit the live site.
components.avoid: Other button colours or shapes; more than one button per block.

components.name: VideoBlock
components.purpose: A film (or an image) in a box with its own proportions, never cropped, with a poster that has content.
components.use: Every video. Give its real width and height. With 'reduce motion' it shows controls instead of playing.
components.avoid: Cropping a film into a square box; a black or empty poster.

components.name: AgentCard
components.purpose: The agent's card on the home: name, line, quote, data and a button to its case. The only thing with a shadow.
components.use: Next to the agent being scanned (home, block 4).
components.avoid: Using its shadow anywhere else; more than one card at a time.

components.name: AgentChip
components.purpose: The name under each agent: grey with a coloured dot at rest, a pill in its colour when active.
components.use: Under the agents on the home; to mark which agent a case belongs to.
components.avoid: Using it as a button by itself.

components.name: Disclosure
components.purpose: A row that opens to show its text.
components.use: Lists where each item has detail most people skip: experience, FAQs.
components.avoid: Hiding the one thing everyone needs to read.

props.title: A row that opens
props.text: Inside, the text in **Satoshi**. It works with the keyboard and without JavaScript.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: A few short texts behind labels; one open at a time. Arrow keys move between them.
components.use: Two to five short, parallel texts (How I work).
components.avoid: Long texts or anything that has to be compared side by side.

items.label: Second
items.text: Only one is **open** at a time.

components.name: NextCase
components.purpose: The way out of a case, into the next one of its zone (Play or Work). Takes the next case's colour on hover.
components.use: At the end of every case.
